title: Contributing to fhktools
text: Bug reports, reproducible examples, documentation improvements, pull requests welcome. opening pull request: Create branch main. Add update test tests/testthat/. Run devtools::test(). Run devtools::check() resolve errors, warnings, notes caused change. Explain change empirical interpretation, especially changes involving shares, group movers, entry exit. Please include confidential firm-level data. Use synthetic, anonymized, minimal reproducible dataset instead.

title: A Practical Guide to FHK Productivity Decomposition
text: unit-level productivity measure pitp_{} period-specific weight share sits_{}, aggregate productivity Pt=∑isitpit.P_t = \sum_i s_{}p_{}. endpoints 0 1, units classified continuers (CC), entrants (EE), exiters (XX). fhktools implements P1−P0=∑∈Csi0(pi1−pi0)+∑∈C(si1−si0)(pi0−P0)+∑∈C(si1−si0)(pi1−pi0)+∑∈Esi1(pi1−P0)−∑∈Xsi0(pi0−P0). \begin{aligned} P_1-P_0 = &\sum_{\C}s_{i0}(p_{i1}-p_{i0}) \\ &+\sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i0}-P_0) \\ &+\sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i1}-p_{i0}) \\ &+\sum_{\E}s_{i1}(p_{i1}-P_0) \\ &-\sum_{\X}s_{i0}(p_{i0}-P_0). \end{aligned} lines correspond within, , cross, entry, exit. returned exit column already contains minus sign. identity algebraic. small residual verifies implementation input consistency, prove productivity, weights, unit identifiers, turnover economically well defined.

title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: 设企业（或工厂）ii 在时期 tt 的生产率为 pitp_{}，权重份额为 sits_{}，则加权平均生产率为 Pt=∑isitpit.P_t=\sum_i s_{}p_{}. 在两个端点之间，企业被划分为延续者 CC、进入者 EE 和退出者 XX。 本包实现的标准 FHK 恒等式为： P1−P0=∑∈Csi0(pi1−pi0)+∑∈C(si1−si0)(pi0−P0)+∑∈C(si1−si0)(pi1−pi0)+∑∈Esi1(pi1−P0)−∑∈Xsi0(pi0−P0). \begin{aligned} P_1-P_0 = &\sum_{\C}s_{i0}(p_{i1}-p_{i0}) \\ &+\sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i0}-P_0) \\ &+\sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i1}-p_{i0}) \\ &+\sum_{\E}s_{i1}(p_{i1}-P_0) \\ &-\sum_{\X}s_{i0}(p_{i0}-P_0). \end{aligned} 五行依次为企业内效应（within）、企业间配置效应（）、交叉效应 （cross）、进入效应（entry）和退出效应（exit）。结果中的 exit 已经包含 公式前面的负号，所以五项可以直接相加。 需要牢记：恒等式闭合只能说明会计计算一致，不能证明生产率、权重、企业 ID 和进入退出定义在经济学上一定正确。

title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: 每个端点期的数据应满足： 每个“分析单位×时期”至多一行； 企业、工厂或企业—产品 ID 跨期一致； 生产率是真正的数值变量； 原始规模或份额非负； 时期变量可以可靠排序，而且不能是 factor。 包内的 fhk_example 是一份三年期、非平衡的合成企业面板： 如果一家企业在同一年有多个工厂，而生产率也是工厂层面的，就必须使用工厂 ID；不能让 match() 随意选择其中一行。本包会在分行业之前检查全局重复， 包括同一企业—时期被放在两个行业的情况。
code: data(fhk_example) str(fhk_example) #> 'data.frame':    20 obs. of  10 variables: #>  $ firm_id              : chr  "A" "B" "C" "D" ... #>  $ year                 : int  2010 2010 2010 2010 2010 2010 2011 2011 2011 2011 ... #>  $ industry             : chr  "Manufacturing" "Manufacturing" "Manufacturing" "Services" ... #>  $ productivity         : num  3.2 2.8 3.6 2.5 2.2 2.9 3.35 3 3.55 2.75 ... #>  $ productivity_alt     : num  3.23 2.78 3.61 2.53 2.18 2.91 3.38 2.98 3.56 2.78 ... #>  $ employment           : num  100 80 60 120 70 50 105 75 62 115 ... #>  $ global_share         : num  0.208 0.167 0.125 0.25 0.146 ... #>  $ within_industry_share: num  0.417 0.333 0.25 0.5 0.292 ... #>  $ first_active_year    : int  2005 2004 2008 2002 2006 2007 2005 2004 2008 2002 ... #>  $ last_active_year     : int  2015 2015 2015 2015 2011 2010 2015 2015 2015 2015 ... head(fhk_example) #>   firm_id year      industry productivity productivity_alt employment #> 1       A 2010 Manufacturing          3.2             3.23        100 #> 2       B 2010 Manufacturing          2.8             2.78         80 #> 3       C 2010 Manufacturing          3.6             3.61         60 #> 4       D 2010      Services          2.5             2.53        120 #> 5       E 2010      Services          2.2             2.18         70 #> 6       F 2010      Services          2.9             2.91         50 #>   global_share within_industry_share first_active_year last_active_year #> 1    0.2083333             0.4166667              2005             2015 #> 2    0.1666667             0.3333333              2004             2015 #> 3    0.1250000             0.2500000              2008             2015 #> 4    0.2500000             0.5000000              2002             2015 #> 5    0.1458333             0.2916667              2006             2011 #> 6    0.1041667             0.2083333              2007             2010

id: 三建议优先传入原始权重
what: 三、建议优先传入原始权重
title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: 就业、销售额或产出等原始规模通常比外部预先计算的份额更稳妥，因为程序会 明确记录两个时期的权重总量，并在正确范围内计算份额。 其中： aggregate_change 是 P1−P0P_1-P_0； component_sum 是五个分项之和； residual 是二者之差； identity_ok 表示残差是否通过缩放容差检验； *_pct 是各分项占有符号总变化的百分比； 如果总变化近似为零，百分比会返回 NA，避免不稳定的除法。
code: result <- fhk_decomposition(   df = fhk_example,   firm_col = "firm_id",   time_col = "year",   prod_col = "productivity",   weight_col = "employment",   t0 = 2010,   t1 = 2012 )  result[, c(   "P0", "P1", "aggregate_change",   "within", "between", "cross", "entry", "exit",   "component_sum", "residual", "identity_ok" )] #>        P0       P1 aggregate_change within     between       cross      entry #> 1 2.83125 3.200192        0.3689423   0.25 0.009827724 -0.02269231 0.04691106 #>         exit component_sum     residual identity_ok #> 1 0.08489583     0.3689423 5.551115e-17        TRUE

id: 四核对进入者退出者和延续者
what: 四、核对进入者、退出者和延续者
title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: 只有两个端点时，程序直接识别的是“样本是否出现”。企业缺席可能来自真实 注销，也可能来自调查轮换、漏报或匹配失败。因此，没有外部生命周期信息时， 论文中应写“样本进入”和“样本退出”。 如果有工商登记式首次、末次经营年份，可以严格核验： 检查规则是： 进入者首次经营期位于 (t0,t1](t_0,t_1]； 退出者末次经营期位于 [t0,t1)[t_0,t_1)； 延续企业在 t0t_0 前已经成立，而且至少经营到 t1t_1。
code: result[, c(   "n_t0", "n_t1", "n_continuers", "n_entrants", "n_exiters",   "share_continuers_t0", "share_continuers_t1",   "share_entrants_t1", "share_exiters_t0" )] #>   n_t0 n_t1 n_continuers n_entrants n_exiters share_continuers_t0 #> 1    6    7            4          3         2                0.75 #>   share_continuers_t1 share_entrants_t1 share_exiters_t0 #> 1           0.6980769         0.3019231             0.25 validated <- fhk_decomposition(   fhk_example,   "firm_id", "year", "productivity", "employment",   2010, 2012,   first_active_col = "first_active_year",   last_active_col = "last_active_year",   turnover_validation = "error" )  validated[, c(   "turnover_basis", "turnover_validated", "n_turnover_mismatches" )] #>                                 turnover_basis turnover_validated #> 1 sample_presence_validated_by_activity_window               TRUE #>   n_turnover_mismatches #> 1                     0

title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: 示例数据同时包含全局份额和行业内份额。全局份额在每个年份对所有企业加总 为 1： 两种结果应当一致。做分行业分解时必须声明份额分母： 份额默认必须在声明范围内加总为 1。程序不会静默重标准化错误的分母。 只有在确有经济学依据时才设置 renormalize_input_shares = TRUE，并保留结果中的 input_share_sum_t0/t1 和 renormalized_t0/t1。
code: global_share_result <- fhk_decomposition(   fhk_example,   "firm_id", "year", "productivity", "global_share",   2010, 2012,   weight_is_share = TRUE )  fields <- c("aggregate_change", "within", "between", "cross", "entry", "exit") rbind(   raw_employment = unlist(result[fields]),   supplied_global_share = unlist(global_share_result[fields]) ) #>                       aggregate_change within     between       cross #> raw_employment               0.3689423   0.25 0.009827724 -0.02269231 #> supplied_global_share        0.3689423   0.25 0.009827724 -0.02269231 #>                            entry       exit #> raw_employment        0.04691106 0.08489583 #> supplied_global_share 0.04691106 0.08489583 by_global_share <- fhk_decomposition(   fhk_example,   "firm_id", "year", "productivity", "global_share",   2010, 2012,   group_cols = "industry",   weight_is_share = TRUE,   share_scope = "global" )  by_within_share <- fhk_decomposition(   fhk_example,   "firm_id", "year", "productivity", "within_industry_share",   2010, 2012,   group_cols = "industry",   weight_is_share = TRUE,   share_scope = "within_group" )

id: 六分行业分解与全国分解
what: 六、分行业分解与全国分解
title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: 每个行业内部的权重会重新标准化。因此，行业分项描述的是“行业内部生产率 动态”，不能把所有行业的 within、等简单相加当成全国结果。 如果既要全国结果又要行业诊断，应使用： 如果只有行业内份额，就无法恢复行业在全国中的规模。层级分析需要原始权重或 全局份额。

"within", "between", "cross",   "entry", "exit", "identity_ok" )] #>        industry aggregate_change within      between        cross       entry #> 1 Manufacturing        0.2557471    0.3 input_share_sum_t1 renormalized_t0 #> 1             520                 NA                 NA           FALSE #>   renormalized_t1  turnover_basis turnover_validated n_turnover_mismatches #> 1 id: 七行业迁移和端点缺失行业
what: 七、行业迁移和端点缺失行业
title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: fhk_complex_example 故意加入了现实数据中常见的问题： 企业 B 在 2012 年改变行业； Construction 只在 2010 年出现； 企业 C 在 2011 年权重为零； 企业 H 在 2011 年缺少另一种生产率指标。 默认分行业调用会因为企业迁移而停止。若行业迁移是真实经济行为，并且研究者 确实希望把它解释为“退出旧行业、进入新行业”，必须显式允许： 行业迁移不是企业成立或注销。因此，有迁移时组内的 turnover_validated 会保持 为 FALSE，而 global_firm_turnover_validated 单独记录企业层面生命周期核验。 如果迁移只是行业分类标准调整，应当先建立跨期统一代码，而不是直接允许迁移。
code: data(fhk_complex_example) subset(   fhk_complex_example,   firm_id %in% c("B", "J") | employment == 0 | is.na(productivity_alt) )[, c("firm_id", "year", "industry", "productivity_alt", "employment")] #>    firm_id year      industry productivity_alt employment #> 2        B 2010 Manufacturing             2.78         80 #> 7        J 2010  Construction             2.68         35 #> 9        B 2011 Manufacturing             2.98         75 #> 10       C 2011 Manufacturing             3.56          0 #> 14       H 2011      Services               NA         55 #> 16       B 2012      Services             3.26         70 complex_result <- fhk_decomposition(   fhk_complex_example,   "firm_id", "year", "productivity", "employment",   2010, 2012,   group_cols = "industry",   first_active_col = "first_active_year",   last_active_col = "last_active_year",   group_change_action = "allow",   incomplete_group_action = "drop" )  attr(complex_result, "skipped_groups") #>       industry present_t0 present_t1 n_rows #> 1 Construction       TRUE      FALSE      1 complex_result[, c(   "industry", "n_group_movers", "turnover_basis",   "turnover_validated", "global_firm_turnover_validated", "identity_ok" )] #>        industry n_group_movers                            turnover_basis #> 1 Manufacturing              1 group_membership_presence_includes_movers #> 2      Services              1 group_membership_presence_includes_movers #>   turnover_validated global_firm_turnover_validated identity_ok #> 1              FALSE                           TRUE        TRUE #> 2              FALSE                           TRUE        TRUE

text: 生产率、权重、ID、时期或组别缺失时，默认报错。设置 na_action = "drop" 可以显式删样，但程序会警告，因为删掉一行可能凭空创造一个“进入者”或 “退出者”。主回归建议使用严格口径；删样口径适合作为经过记录的稳健性检验。 零权重默认保留并报告。它不影响加权平均值，但仍影响基于“是否出现”的分类。 可改为： 任何时期或行业的权重总和为零时，都无法进行分解。
code: zero_weight_action = "drop"   # 警告后删除 zero_weight_action = "error"  # 直接拒绝

title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: expected_step = 1 会阻止程序把缺失 2011 年后的 2010–2012 误称为“相邻年度”。 程序使用全样本共同的时期端点，所以不同产业会在同一对年份上比较。 长差分和逐年分解含义不同：一家企业可能在 2010 年后进入、2012 年前退出， 因而在长差分两个端点都不存在，却会出现在逐年分解中。
code: annual <- fhk_adjacent(   fhk_example,   "firm_id", "year", "productivity", "employment",   expected_step = 1 )  annual[, c(   "period_start", "period_end", "aggregate_change",   "n_entrants", "n_exiters", "identity_ok" )] #>   period_start period_end aggregate_change n_entrants n_exiters identity_ok #> 1         2010       2011       0.09863281          2         1        TRUE #> 2         2011       2012       0.27030950          1         1        TRUE

title: FHK 生产率分解：中文完整教程
text: 至少应当说明或在复现材料中保存： 分析单位是企业、工厂还是企业—产品，ID 如何构造； 端点年份，以及使用长差分还是逐年转移； 生产率是水平还是对数，采用哪一种估计方法； 权重是就业、销售还是产出，份额分母范围是什么； 行业代码是否跨期统一，如何处理迁移企业； 进入退出是样本定义还是工商登记核验； 缺失值、零权重、端点缺组的处理政策； 延续者、进入者、退出者的数量和权重占比； 五项分解、residual 和 identity_ok。 建议在筛选论文表格列之前，先保存程序返回的完整数据框。审计列是实证记录的一 部分，不应只保留五个分项。

title: fhktools: Robust FHK productivity decomposition
text: fhktools defensive, dependency-free R implementation standard Foster–Haltiwanger–Krizan (FHK) productivity decomposition. designed empirical panels duplicated units, malformed shares, industry-code changes, survey rotation, missing values, ambiguous entry/exit definitions real concerns. 中文用户请参阅中文完整教程。English step--step guide available introductory vignette.

title: fhktools: Robust FHK productivity decomposition
text: Many short FHK scripts reproduce five-term accounting formula silently make consequential data decisions. fhktools separates three questions: accounting identity close? Every result reports scaled residual identity_ok. input shares panel keys valid? Unsafe factor--numeric conversions, duplicated unit-period rows, negative weights, missing group labels, malformed shares rejected default. turnover mean? Without registry information, entry exit explicitly labeled sample presence. Firm birth/death, sample turnover, movement industries kept conceptually separate. endpoint identity ΔP=Within++Cross+Entry+Exit,\Delta P = \text{Within} + \text{} + \text{Cross}            + \text{Entry} + \text{Exit}, Within=∑∈Csi0(pi1−pi0),=∑∈C(si1−si0)(pi0−P0),Cross=∑∈C(si1−si0)(pi1−pi0),Entry=∑∈Esi1(pi1−P0),Exit=−∑∈Xsi0(pi0−P0).\begin{aligned} \text{Within}  &= \sum_{\C}s_{i0}(p_{i1}-p_{i0}),\\ \text{} &= \sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i0}-P_0),\\ \text{Cross}   &= \sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i1}-p_{i0}),\\ \text{Entry}   &= \sum_{\E}s_{i1}(p_{i1}-P_0),\\ \text{Exit}    &= -\sum_{\X}s_{i0}(p_{i0}-P_0). \end{aligned} returned exit component already contains leading minus sign.

title: fhktools: Robust FHK productivity decomposition
text: package includes synthetic, unbalanced firm panel genuine endpoint entry exit, stable industry codes, raw employment, global shares, within-industry shares, registry-style activity windows. Raw sales, employment, output weights usually safest package can construct period-specific shares transparent denominator. aggregate_change equals sum five components floating-point rounding. Percentage columns signed contributions relative signed aggregate change. NA aggregate change close zero.
code: library(fhktools) data(fhk_example) head(fhk_example[, c("firm_id", "year", "industry", "productivity", "employment")]) #>   firm_id year      industry productivity employment #> 1       A 2010 Manufacturing          3.2        100 #> 2       B 2010 Manufacturing          2.8         80 #> 3       C 2010 Manufacturing          3.6         60 #> 4       D 2010      Services          2.5        120 #> 5       E 2010      Services          2.2         70 #> 6       F 2010      Services          2.9         50 overall <- fhk_decomposition(   fhk_example,   firm_col = "firm_id",   time_col = "year",   prod_col = "productivity",   weight_col = "employment",   t0 = 2010,   t1 = 2012 )  round(overall[, c(   "aggregate_change", "within", "between", "cross", "entry", "exit",   "residual" )], 6) #>   aggregate_change within  between     cross    entry     exit residual #> 1         0.368942   0.25 0.009828 -0.022692 0.046911 0.084896        0

title: Compute a Robust Two-Period FHK Decomposition — fhk_decomposition
text: Let \(P_t = \sum_i s_{}p_{}\). implemented endpoint identity $$\Delta P = Within + + Cross + Entry + Exit,$$ $$Within = \sum_{\C} s_{i0}(p_{i1}-p_{i0}),$$ $$= \sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i0}-P_0),$$ $$Cross = \sum_{\C}(s_{i1}-s_{i0})(p_{i1}-p_{i0}),$$ $$Entry = \sum_{\E}s_{i1}(p_{i1}-P_0),$$ $$Exit = -\sum_{\X}s_{i0}(p_{i0}-P_0).$$ returned exit value already includes leading minus sign can therefore added directly four components. Without external activity-window information, entry exit mean sample entry sample exit endpoints. accounting identity can exact even underlying turnover interpretation wrong, users inspect audit columns.

title: Robust Foster-Haltiwanger-Krizan Productivity Decompositions — fhktools-package
text: fhktools provides defensive implementations standard Foster-Haltiwanger-Krizan (FHK) productivity decomposition. emphasizes auditable data choices, explicit turnover interpretation, exact accounting identity checks.

title: Robust Foster-Haltiwanger-Krizan Productivity Decompositions — fhktools-package
text: main entry points fhk_decomposition() one endpoint pair, fhk_adjacent() consecutive observed periods, fhk_hierarchical() economy-wide plus within-group results, fhk_multi_measure() comparable results across several productivity measures.

title: fhktools 0.1.0
text: Initial public release. Adds strict two-period FHK decomposition accounting-identity audits. Supports raw size weights, within-group shares, global shares. Adds grouped, hierarchical, adjacent-period, multi-measure workflows. Distinguishes sample presence, group membership changes, registry-validated firm entry exit. Includes clean deliberately complex example panel datasets.
